title: herbal springy hash middle-eastern chicken skillet
description: a flavorful and healthy middle-eastern inspired skillet dish featuring panang curry paste and agave leaf
instructions: heat the coconut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
add the chicken breast and cook until browned on both sides, about 5-6 minutes total.
remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
add the panang curry paste to the skillet and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
add the onion and bell pepper to the skillet and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
add the garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
add the gluten-free flour to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
add the chicken broth to the skillet and stir to combine.
return the chicken to the skillet and cook until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce has thickened, about 5-7 minutes.
season the chicken with salt, black pepper, and lemon juice.
garnish with chopped fresh parsley and cilantro.
